title: Honor explicit protocol choices, HyperSnap as the default reader
changes: Set HyperSnap v2 as the explicit default indexed read selection in ordinary deployments; preserve explicit user choices, compatible read fallback opt-in and strict self-hosted policy.
Expose a configured compatible Farcaster hosted reader as a selectable provider while rejecting unconfigured endpoints.
Keep signing and message submission routed through user-selected capability-compatible writer adapters; never misrepresent an indexed reader as a signer provider.
Preserve automatic signature use of already authorized local device signers; no unsafe claim that entering a recovery phrase alone establishes network KEY_ADD authorization.
